research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen/indexed APH occupations and maiden speech, contemporary legal press, Law Access 2017/18 and Law Society 2015/16 annual reports, public professional-history search. APH speech direct open failed; indexed official text available. Current personal biography URL inaccessible; primary-source search also returned unrelated results. No access controls bypassed.

Priority follow-up: CDPP appointment/cessation and ordinary versus ministerial DPC employment; precise iiNet and family-firm work/study overlaps. Obtain employment hours and unpaid/campaign leave, especially 2013 preselection and 2015/2016 campaigns. July 2013 full-time confirmation cannot support all 2011–16.

Check earlier Law Access reports for founding chair term and Street Law Centre/Starick governance leads. Public professional-history index supplied unverified month-level dates, not adopted without primary corroboration. Confirm other early work and career breaks; governance/service roles do not establish additional full-time employment.
